issues.title: [N11] Raveldex-native consumer identity and usability
issues.body:
<!-- raveldex:N11:start -->
Create a recognizable Raveldex consumer search experience with clear result context, optional explanations and coherent host-friendly styling; familiar interactions and migration guides support adoption without copying Pagefind.

**Track:** release. **Progress:** 0/12 tasks accepted.

**Exit criteria**

- One implemented Raveldex visual and interaction direction defines hierarchy, density, typography, spacing, emphasis and state treatments across inline, modal, dropdown, directory and cards; competitor resemblance is not an acceptance criterion.
- First-time Raveldex integration is the primary journey; optional Pagefind migration material states differences honestly without dictating APIs, layout or feature parity.
- Search, filters, paging, reset/retry, localization and CMS lifecycle remain understandable and preserve exact native results, focus, composition, safe rendering and cleanup.
- Risk-based installed behavior/visual checks and a focused human accessibility walkthrough qualify the changed candidate; unobserved expanded combinations remain explicit limitations instead of triggering an exhaustive benchmark/platform prerequisite.
- N11 proceeds independently of comparative N10 research using stable public contracts and isolated artifacts; no new engine capability, dependency, deployment or publication is implied.

**Task checklist**

- [ ] [RX-9101](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/81) — Define Raveldex identity and consumer interaction contract
- [ ] [RX-9102](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/82) — Lead with Raveldex adoption and separate migration guidance
- [ ] [RX-9103](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/83) — Clarify idle filter availability and reset behavior
- [ ] [RX-9104](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/84) — Simplify pagination presentation while preserving focus
- [ ] [RX-9105](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/85) — Polish search states and recovery messages
- [ ] [RX-9106](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/86) — Make keyboard guidance discoverable and consistent
- [ ] [RX-9107](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/87) — Implement Raveldex visual tokens and coherent consumer styling
- [ ] [RX-9108](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/88) — Provide coherent localization and message customization
- [ ] [RX-9109](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/89) — Define native result hierarchy and rich-content compatibility
- [ ] [RX-9110](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/90) — Explain directory counts and multi-select filtering plainly
- [ ] [RX-9111](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/91) — Document safe CMS refresh, remount and state preservation
- [ ] [RX-9112](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/issues/92) — Qualify the Raveldex experience with a finite interaction review

Roadmap: [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/blob/main/ROADMAP.md). Task detail: [IMPLEMENTATION_TASKS.md](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/blob/main/IMPLEMENTATION_TASKS.md).

Closing this overview alone does not complete its tasks. Completion requires accepted evidence in the canonical roadmap.
<!-- raveldex:N11:end -->

<!-- raveldex:scope-amendment-20261107 -->
### Current scope — 7 November 2026

The owner-selected [qualification and original-identity amendment](https://github.com/vmitsaras/raveldex/blob/main/docs/planning/SCOPED_QUALIFICATION_AND_IDENTITY_20261107.md) and managed task criteria above supersede contradictory **future-work** instructions in earlier registration notes below. Historical observations and discussion are preserved. The full 450-minute experiment is optional; N11 does not await RX-9007. No task or unrun test is completed by this edit.


## Maintainer notes

Discussion and notes outside the managed block are preserved by synchronization.

## Planning contract and review basis


## Status and outcome

Planned on 5 November 2026 from the owner's plugin UI/UX and persona review. This selects planning and GitHub registration only; no plugin, CSS, demo, dependency or public API implementation is part of registration. Execution follows N10's accepted closeout so its measured candidate and serial collection remain undisturbed. No deadline or assignee is inferred.

The outcome is a familiar, understandable and consistent consumer search experience for people adopting Raveldex, including Pagefind migrants. Scope covers the shipped inline, modal, dropdown, directory and cards add-ons and their integration guidance. The legacy developer workbench remains supported under its existing contract.

## Evidence and limitations

The preceding review inspected current source, public contracts, existing tests and retained component screenshots. It did not run fresh browser tests, measure contrast or observe screen-reader speech, physical keyboards, mobile keyboards or actual browser zoom. Existing tests are coverage evidence, not a fresh passing run. Findings describe adoption and polish gaps; deliberate contracts are not automatically implementation defects.

Current source anchors include `src/addons/ui/inline.ts`, `inline-render.ts`, `inline.css`, `dropdown.ts`, `dropdown.css`, `modal.ts`, `modal.css`, `directory-view-mount.ts`, `directory-view-options.ts`, `directory.css`, `types.ts` and `directory-cards-types.ts`. Public contracts live in the related search-solution, modal, dropdown and directory specifications and `docs/api/HOSTS.md`.

## Reviewed findings and task coverage

| Finding | Impact | Planned task |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F01: Primary integration guidance can lead a consumer to the legacy workbench, with Inspector and numerical scores, before the consumer presets. | High | RX-9102 |
| F02: Idle inline/modal facet controls initially offer only All; buckets require a successful query and are reset when cleared. | High | RX-9103 |
| F03: Load more, Previous and Next expose multiple pagination concepts and persistent unavailable controls. Persistence currently protects focus. | Medium | RX-9104 |
| F04: Technical count/error copy, generic empty states and an ambiguous Clear label make recovery harder. Clear currently resets query and filters. | Medium | RX-9103, RX-9105 |
| F05: Dropdown selection keys and surface-specific Escape behavior need clearer discoverability. | Medium | RX-9106 |
| F06: Theme behavior, result-link target comfort and narrow header layouts differ across consumer surfaces. | Medium | RX-9107 |
| F07: English defaults and partial message overrides need a coherent localization adoption path. | Medium | RX-9108 |
| F08: Rich metadata and generated matching snippets/sections are available through different surface contracts. | Medium | RX-9102, RX-9109 |
| F09: Counts describe the fully filtered set; a zero-count unselected OR option can still expand the result set when added. | Medium | RX-9110 |
| F10: Captured display data and repeated mounts need clearer CMS refresh/remount and state-preservation guidance. | Medium | RX-9111 |

RX-9101 establishes the scenario/state contract; RX-9112 verifies the complete outcome. All tasks start planned with no completion evidence.

## Personas and observable scenarios

| Persona | Scenario and expected outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Pagefind adopter maintaining a static documentation site | Chooses inline/modal/dropdown from a clear capability map, prepares explicit records and heading targets, installs only needed modules/CSS, and reaches consumer search without accidentally choosing the workbench. |
| Visitor with cognitive or attention constraints | Understands idle filter availability, submits a query, changes filters, reaches zero results and recovers without guessing what reset will erase. |
| Keyboard-only researcher | Enters a query, discovers dropdown selection keys, follows a native result link, loads another batch and retains a predictable focus location and path to new content. |
| Screen-reader user | Distinguishes idle, settled loading, result totals, appended results, empty and failed requests; can retry without stale replies or duplicate announcements taking over. Speech requires human observation. |
| Mobile visitor with limited dexterity | Uses a compact search header and result links comfortably, opens/dismisses a modal, and can reach actions while the on-screen keyboard is present. |
| Low-vision multilingual visitor | Reads long translated labels in LTR/RTL, host light/dark themes, forced colors, narrow viewports and actual enlarged browser zoom without losing information or focus. |
| CMS integrator maintaining a live catalogue | Applies an engine update, refreshes or remounts captured display data deliberately, restores app-owned query/filter state where supported and releases UI/engine resources in the documented order. |
| Directory shopper | Adds a second OR choice after selecting the first, understands what displayed counts describe, and can remove filters without zero-count choices being wrongly disabled. |

For each applicable surface, the contract must cover idle, composing, loading, results, append/window navigation, empty, failure/retry, clear/reset, close/reopen, refresh and destroy. Include delayed/out-of-order responses, long text, missing optional capabilities and multiple instances where relevant. Preserve native browser link and editing behavior.

## Fixed boundaries and decision gates

- Preserve native TypeScript/ESM, optional DOM/CSS/providers, no foreign engine, no new runtime dependency and no core import-time host effects.
- Preserve exact totals, deterministic native order/scores, original source offsets, revision consistency, capability failures, cancellation, stale-response suppression, IME handling, safe text insertion and teardown/borrowed-engine ownership.
- Do not alter the frozen legacy workbench or change its omitted-mode semantics to improve consumer adoption; correct the route to consumer presets instead.
- Idle search currently performs no automatic query. Do not silently introduce browse-all searches to populate filters. Prefer truthful guidance or presentation under that contract. A new browse action or changed idle contract needs an explicit product decision first.
- Persistent navigation protects focus. Any simpler presentation must establish how a focused control survives result transitions and how appended content is discovered before replacing the behavior.
- Counts remain conjunctive over the complete current filtered set; OR-within/AND-across groups remains unchanged. Disjunctive or predicted counts are outside this milestone unless separately selected.
- Rich-result work first produces a capability matrix and a bounded compatibility decision. A shared display API, renderer callback or added retained metadata is not implicitly approved. A documented keep-current decision can complete that decision task; extension implementation requires separate selection.
- Localization reuses explicit message capture/overrides where possible. Automatic page-language selection, plural/number formatting APIs or new public fields must be specified before adoption; UI translation is separate from query analysis.
- Do not add a crawler, background polling, live subscription or new persistence layer to imitate another product. Static indexing remains explicit and CMS state remains app-owned under existing contracts.
- Do not redesign demo pages, change ranking, raise engine limits, publish packages, deploy, tag or release as part of N11. Test fixtures and usage documentation may change only to prove or explain plugin behavior.

## Sequence and completion gate

RX-9101 follows RX-9007 and confirms the state/decision matrix before implementation. RX-9102–RX-9111 follow that contract; localization follows settled copy/keyboard/count messages. RX-9112 depends on every delivery/decision task. Parallel edits to shared UI/message files need explicit ownership; timing collectors remain serial with no builds/tests alongside them.

Completion requires behavior-level regression evidence for changed states, installed consumer verification of each affected surface, visual review under the agreed theme/responsive/translation matrix, and a reviewed scenario report mapping outcomes to acceptance criteria. Capture actual browser/OS/assistive-technology versions and distinguish automated keyboard checks from human speech, actual zoom and physical-device observations. Required unavailable observations remain Blocked or Not run; they are not inferred from screenshots, emulation or axe.

Record actual commands, reviewed source/artifact identities, limitations and review outcomes in each produced `docs/evidence/RX-91xx.md` before marking that task done. Only existing evidence paths belong in the canonical manifest. Keep public guidance, relevant specifications, generated plans and GitHub state aligned; publication remains separate.

## Migration references

The review consulted Pagefind's [current component UI](https://pagefind.app/docs/search-ui/), [supported default UI](https://pagefind.app/docs/ui-usage/), [default UI options](https://pagefind.app/docs/ui/) and [static build integration](https://pagefind.app/docs/running-pagefind/). These establish migration expectations, not an obligation to copy APIs, custom elements or architecture. Recheck official documentation before writing version-sensitive migration claims.

## Registration boundary

The owner requested a new milestone with native sub-issues based on the plugin UI/UX review. These issues register planned work only. Companion manifest/specification changes are local and uncommitted at registration; the acceptance criteria in these issue bodies are self-contained until those files reach main. N10 closeout remains the first prerequisite; this registration does not implement plugins or synchronize unrelated tracking.
